trigger: an operator holding a kill-switch OFF row on __guard__.push_rules or quarantine.* upgrades; the changelog says No upgrade action and the hold silently ends
classification_rationale: a breaking security-relevant behaviour change had no upgrade note and was filed as a fix
summary: Breaking change (the push_rules emergency stop is inert; quarantine rows no longer stop dispatch) was disclosed as .fixed with no upgrade action. Enterprise-readiness and compliance-officer echoed it after seeing the digest. Fixed: .changed.md with a Breaking entry plus an upgrading.md section (find held rows, re-establish the stop through rules first, rollback, mixed replicas).

trigger: a protective dispatch to a device that genuinely lacks the quarantine plugin
classification_rationale: dispatch_confirmed now means acceptance only for such a device; the agent's plugin-not-found arrives asynchronously
summary: Skipping the missing-plugin filter for protective pairs means a plugin-less device returns agents_reached=1 and dispatch_confirmed instead of a retryable zero-reach error. Happy-path graded the same fact INFO. The exemption is an approved plan decision; the reversal half was rejected and mitigated by wording (upgrading.md, alert description). Travels to the push gate for the product owner.
adjudicated_by: Architect (snr-dev gate adjudication), independent of the change's author
adjudication_rationale: Exemption of the missing-plugin filter for protective pairs was an approved plan decision (product owner); dispatch_confirmed is already contractually acceptance-only (mcp_server.cpp output schema, upgrading.md). Mitigation adopted: verify with quarantine.status, upgrade agents first, alert description sentence. Reversal rejected.

trigger: an operator sets the __guard__.push_rules kill switch mid-incident: 200, enabled=false echoed, audit success, rules keep flowing
classification_rationale: the evidence surfaces implied a stop that does not exist
summary: Within the product owner's document-only scope: the audit detail now carries protective_exempt=true (REST and MCP, shared helper), one warn log after the store write, the replacement lever and its disarm-on-reconcile semantics documented (guaranteed-state.md, upgrading.md, MCP/REST descriptions), required permissions named. No refusal, no output field, no counter.
adjudicated_by: Architect (snr-dev gate adjudication), independent of the change's author
adjudication_rationale: The audit-detail token and warn log add no refusal, no output field and no counter, so they sit inside the document-only write-surface ruling; sre and compliance-officer recommended them as the cheapest compliant signal.

trigger: configure_presence reassigns the std::function reader and ttl without presence_cache_mu_ while live_presence invokes it
classification_rationale: reported by security-guardian, architect, cpp-safety and unhappy-path independently (Gate 2 ran in parallel)
summary: Latent data race (safe today only by wiring/teardown quiescence). Fixed: both overloads and live_presence take presence_cache_mu_, cache age resets on reconfigure; a condition-variable interleaving test fails 4 assertions with the lock removed (3 of 3 runs, 20 of 20 under load).

trigger: rolling back to the previous server while OFF rows for protective pairs are stored
classification_rationale: the rollback caveat was missing from the upgrade note
summary: An older server honours stored OFF rows for protective pairs again. Fixed in the upgrading.md section: PUT enabled=true on every protective-pair row before rolling back; mixed-replica note.

trigger: a reader of ADR-3005 concludes the quarantine four were already exempt from the kill switch
classification_rationale: only the containment gate exempted the four before this change
summary: Fixed: the ADR names the four as newly exempt and scopes the must to non-protective pairs.

trigger: a SIEM rule or script matches the kill-switch audit detail by strict equality enabled=false on a protective-pair write
classification_rationale: the audit table is the SIEM contract and still said enabled=true|false
summary: Found independently by enterprise-readiness, docs-writer and consistency-auditor in Gate 8. Fixed with one clause naming protective_exempt=true.

trigger: a future edit drops the action argument at command_routes.cpp or the legacy-forward caller
classification_rationale: mutation run: both callers survive an empty action argument; the ladder caller is pinned
summary: Closed by new tests pinning the action argument at both production callers.

trigger: the A5 exception ledger requires an issue number and revisit-by date; the new row cites ADR-3006 D3
classification_rationale: the ledger doc says each entry names an issue number
summary: The A5 ledger row's Issue column now cites #5761 (kill-switch typed protective field and write refusal), filed with the product owner's go.
